task_title: Exit asset worker promptly after durable producer completion

plan_review.notes: Adopted unique per-run marker cleanup/preflight; executable shell success/failure/signal/pre-exit tests; concurrency=2 worker integration benchmark; explicit post-marker next-run boundary; documented acceptable preexisting-backlog processing before ingest completes.

independent_grade.notes: The diff effectively implements a deterministic, file-based drain marker to replace the arbitrary timeout polling. It correctly encapsulates the logic within a robust shell script handling interrupts, adds the necessary checks to the worker CLI, fixes a concurrency lock memory leak in worker.ts that was surfaced by the new concurrency tests, and includes excellent unit and benchmark coverage for the new behaviors and race conditions.
